headline: Biogen Completes Acquisition of RayThera Inc.
summary: Lead program now in Phase 1 developmentCAMBRIDGE, Mass., Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Biogen Inc. (Nasdaq: BIIB) today announced the completion of the acquisition of RayThera Inc., a privately held biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing small-molecule therapies in immunology.
